Pixel art exact teal glass, diagonal blue reflections, steel cream dark borders, central little silver handles. Transparent sheet 4 columns x2 rows, equal cells, 8 chronological poses. Frame0 closed at center; frames1..6 slide left leaf left and right leaf right monotonically; frame7 gap wide enough for a person, leaves fully retracted to edges. Each leaf same size throughout, fixed ground baseline, enough outer transparent margins. No static posts, rail, floor, plants, walls, people, text, checkerboard. Match original office entrance, front/top-down scene perspective; keep proportions wider than meeting room door. True transparent alpha.

Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this exact office scene. Make only THREE requested localized practical changes, preserve camera, pixel-art style, all walls, all other objects and colors exactly. (1) Clear exterior entrance at bottom center x548..697 y1014..1103 of two movable glass door leaves and central stile; retain static side posts and top beam and exterior teal mat; restore clear connected floor through doorway, no movable leaves drawn. (2) The low filing cabinet immediately above entrance, x541..770 y847..989 including its plant, must shift UP by about60 pixels, keeping identical shape and scale, restoring warm wooden floor where it was; this creates a clear interior approach corridor above entrance. Do NOT move printer left of cabinet. (3) Within orange lounge rug only, move the teal lounge ARMCHAIR about20px left and25px down to clear the rug's top-left corner for a later TV cabinet. Keep blue sofa and coffee table exactly where they are; restore rug behind moved chair. Do NOT add television, cabinet or console yet, those will be separate sprites. No people, no new decorations, no text. Keep both already clear inner doorways clear. Output same square full scene composition.

Use case: stylized-concept. Reference is warm wood/teal office lounge style. Create EIGHT consistent states of ONE compact TV/media cabinet, transparent sprite sheet 4 columns x2 rows equal cells. Cabinet golden oak wood, one low sliding drawer, short dark feet; above it large black flat TV screen angled slightly toward bottom-right matching top-down pixel office camera. White-and-black PlayStation-style console and two white gamepads, no logos or text. Same object size, camera, anchor and scale in ALL eight cells. Chronological/semantic row-major states: 0 drawer closed, console hidden inside, TV off. 1 drawer half open, console partly visible stored inside, TV off. 2 drawer fully open, console and two pads visible in drawer, TV off. 3 drawer fully open EMPTY after pickup, TV off. 4 drawer half open EMPTY, TV off. 5 drawer closed with white-black console installed ON TOP of cabinet next to TV, TV off. 6 same installed console, TV ON showing colorful abstract racing game track (no text) and blue power light. 7 same installed console, TV ON showing simple pause/menu icons without text. Full appliance assembly should be wider than tall, compact enough for lounge corner. Keep top TV, side cabinet geometry and outline pixel-perfect consistent; drawer projects toward foreground in open states. EXACT8 cells, no other furniture, no floor, no people, no labels, no checkerboard, TRUE alpha transparency.
